title: Plain G1 ECDLP: (6,2) STNFS on a twisted C4 base field behind a run gate: expected work 2^116.005138119602

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x from T=[x]P0 via z=e(T,Q0)=g^x, g=e(P0,Q0), with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^114.0402364642+2^66) < 2^116.005138119602 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000; a core unit of 20,000 instructions = 10 units): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7201352326197334294, (K/2^64) x 0.999011 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.999011 and costs at most 2^125.227897983888 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
